messages:
pager-bot: 🚨 HIGH - /inference/gateway error rate spike (5xx) — 1728625300

alice.m: grabbing the bridge, looking at metrics now.

alice.m: spikes started ~1728625200, p95 latency up, errors mainly 502 from gateway.

bob.t: I'm on DB read replicas, running quick health check.

bob.t: logs show `error: upstream read timeout` from node pool-gamma.

carol_ops: customer impact: support queue shows 12 customers reporting timeouts, none are billing-critical yet. logging ticket numbers.

alice.m: mitigations: 1) disable autoscale burst to reduce pressure 2) route traffic away from pool-gamma to pool-beta 3) increase gateway retry budget. Applying step 1 now.

pager-bot: action applied: autoscale burst disabled by infra-cfg@1728625320

bob.t: routing switch started: `route set --from pool-gamma --to pool-beta --weight 0.2` (gradual)

frank_sre: adding KV cache short-circuit for common prefixes to reduce load. will push patch in 2m.

erin_research: noting for post-incident: model-serving host churn + oversized batch window correlated with timeouts. saving sample logs.`

gita_eng: can you paste the small log snippet?

bob.t: snippet: ```
[2026-03-04T12:15:23Z] gateway node=pool-gamma msg="upstream read timeout" duration=30s req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate
[2026-03-04T12:15:24Z] shard=3 evicted-kv=true
```

carol_ops: customer-impact summary draft: ~4% of requests saw errors, concentrated in APAC region between 12:14-12:22 UTC, estimated 12 customers with timeouts, no data exfiltration. will add to ticket.

alice.m: routing and cache changes reduced errors to baseline. keep monitoring for 10m then we can close pager.

pager-bot: incident severity downgraded to MEDIUM at 1728625405 — automated alerting resuming.

dave_pm: let's schedule a follow-up post-incident sync. proposed: 1728629000 (same day, 3h after) — owners: alice.m (incident lead), erin_research (RCA draft), gita_eng (timeline), carol_ops (customer impact), frank_sre (mitigation).

erin_research: I'll start RCA draft after runbook checks, will include timeline, contributing factors, and suggested remediation (fix autoscale tune, add circuit-breaker).

frank_sre: temporary action item: revert autoscale-burst change only after controlled canary. (action: frank_sre)

gita_eng: I'll collect kernel + runtime metrics and attach sequence length distribution; need 24h logs. (action: gita_eng)

carol_ops: I'll prepare customer notification draft for affected accounts and route to legal. (action: carol_ops)

legal_bot: Reminder: if notifying customers include only factual impact + mitigation steps; loop in security@redwood for pre-approval.

erin_research: RCA draft outline: 1) timeline 2) facts/evidence 3) contributing factors 4) mitigations applied 5) recommended long-term fixes 6) owners and ETA. Will post initial draft by 1728627000.

bob.t: FYI I pushed a small guard in pool-gamma to fail fast on overloaded upstreams, reduces queueing. (deployed 1728625455)

alice.m: thanks team. we'll reconvene at follow-up. leaving notes in the incident tracker with action items. :thumbsup:

carol_ops: added support ticket IDs and links to incident tracker.

erin_research: posted RCA draft v0.1: https://redwood.internal/notes/INC-1728625300/rca-draft (please review)

gita_eng: reviewing now, will comment inline on timeline accuracy.

frank_sre: will validate mitigation steps and mark temporary fixes as "rollback after canary".

gita_eng: marking timeline entry: "12:14:22 - initial spike, 12:15:30 - routing change, 12:20:00 - errors back to baseline" — confirm pls.

alice.m: confirmed.

carol_ops: customer notification queued for legal review.

legal_bot: Approved draft language at 1728625760. OK to send after product review.

erin_research: adding reviewers: @gita_eng @frank_sre @dave_pm — please sign off by 1728628500.

dave_pm: signed off on draft at 1728625799 — leaving a note to track follow-up deliverables in the postmortem doc.

alice.m: closing bridge, leaving handoff notes for post-incident sync.

pager-bot: incident closed (auto) at 1728625800 — summary: gateway upstream timeouts caused transient customer-facing errors, mitigated by routing and cache short-circuit, RCA draft created and assigned.
